description: The GATED driver-GREEN honest-verify live check, config-driven so anyone can point it at their own Lakebase-enabled workspace. The host is a DEFAULT (fevm-serverless-stable-ecparr) resolved by loadRunConfig against ${DATABRICKS_HOST}; override by exporting DATABRICKS_HOST (run-all-live-tests.sh does this from --profile). Same setup/teardown lifecycle kinds as the stockflow demo (scaffold-project / remove-project from the lifecycle catalogue). The driver-GREEN turn itself runs on the uncontained live executor between these ops (see driver-build-support.ts).
